speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates
speckit.author: GitHub

bugfix.name: Guided Bug Fix
bugfix.description: Runs bug assess → human review gate → bug fix → bug test on a bug report
bugfix.author: GitHub

assess.name: Idea Assessment Pipeline
assess.description: Runs intake → research → define → shape → decide with a verdict review gate before a manual specify handoff
assess.author: GitHub

autopilot-epic.name: Autopilot Epic Pipe
autopilot-epic.description: One epic, unattended: specify → plan → tasks, then implement → converge → gate → independent review until the deterministic gate passes or a cap is hit
autopilot-epic.author: GitHub

autopilot.name: Autopilot Conductor
autopilot.description: Plans epics from requirements, then runs them unattended as parallel autopilot-epic pipes in git worktrees, merging each into an integration branch; human gates on the epic plan and the final merge
autopilot.author: GitHub
